description: Defines the NtlmClient class for implementing NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 authentication protocols, including methods for generating negotiate and authenticate messages, with support for extended features like MIC and EPA.

classes.name: NtlmClient
classes.description: Implements NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 client with support for MIC and EPA, providing methods to generate NTLM negotiation and authentication messages.

methods.name: GenerateAuthenticateMessage
methods.description: Generates the NTLM authenticate message with detailed parameters including domain, username, password, hostname, channel bindings, SPN, client time, and server challenge.

methods.name: GenerateAuthenticateMessageV1
methods.description: Simplified method for NTLMv1 authentication, omitting some parameters.
